_evidence.join: Directed second-read audit over every one-to-one DM (12 lanes; chat search never reaches them). Seventy-five authored 'quick look at my draft' requests each carry a designed, contested response timing. A request is timely when the reviewer comes back to the asker with the *read itself* — a verdict on the draft, in the same DM or by a directed 'Draft read' email — by the end of the next working day, holidays skipped. A holding acknowledgement ('got it, I'll look tonight') is not the read.
_evidence.traps: Most rows punish the surface reading. Same-day evening reads land on the next UTC calendar day, so a machine-time reader over-counts next_working_day. Many reviewers post a same-day acknowledgement and deliver the actual read only the next working day, so counting the first reply back mis-classifies them. Eleven reads arrive by email, invisible to a chat-only sweep. Friday and pre-holiday asks answered the next working day are timely only if weekends and the federal holidays (05-25 Memorial Day, 06-19 Juneteenth) are skipped. Two re-sent requests are answered on their re-sent instance, leaving the original unanswered.
_evidence.grading: The 75-row response ledger carries the bulk weight under normalized multiset F1 plus exact certification; the exception summaries, aggregates, and ledger reconciliation are graded separately, so a headline-only answer cannot reach half credit.
